description: Unified creative and automation ecosystem for character-locked, visually consistent storytelling across AI tools.

vision.style: Cinematic cartoon meets luxury fashion meets anime noir
vision.mission: Unify storytelling, AI automation, and creator empowerment into a persistent anime-style visual universe

character_locking.rules: Once locked, a character’s appearance, costume, facial style, silhouette, and animation style are fixed. Only pose, lighting, or environment may change post-lock.

visual_rules.color_palette: Sepia tones with color pop in red
visual_rules.consistency: Linework, lighting, proportions must match across all generations

features: Holographic signs: 'VIP', 'TIME MACHINE PARKING ONLY', 'CHRONO-LANE ACCESS'
Futuristic red carpet with smart floor and drone lights

ai_voice_pipeline.policy: Pay real voice actors or use opt-in licensed clones

automation_stack.manga_channel: Automated with AI voice + visual branding

prompt_engineering.prompt_style: Stylized, cinematic, includes camera emulation and lighting cues
prompt_engineering.example_prompt: Create a stylized night scene in sepia tones showing Vuk and his wife outside the futuristic venue 'Foxies.' Only the red hat glows, matching the La Siluta bottle. Shot in portrait style with fashion lens emulation.

governance.response_protocol: Ask for clarification if ambiguity is detected. Maintain scene fidelity. Use placeholder IDs until lock.
governance.version_control: Scene reviews every 10 iterations, final locks archived
governance.collaboration: Feedback loop with 3-step process: Test → Lock → Archive

actions: Trigger on new manga release via Apify
Send chapter data to AI narrator
Auto-publish video with branding overlay to YouTube
